lines.s: The High Lines: the gondola and the cage now wait until a hero is aboard.
In co-op the car holds a moment for a partner who is close.
A missed line drops you into a net: it costs 10% health, never your last point.
Strike on the net and its winch hauls you back to the ledge you fell from.
Five shrines now stand on the main climb, so a death costs less ground.
The High Lines: Skyhook's arena is now the mouth of a rock cave, not a brick hall.
Ore-road rails run out under hung lamps to a small patch of daylight.
The fight is unchanged; every tell and lever reads against the darker stone.
The High Lines: one blow starts a line, and it carries you all the way up.
Levers set the points: strike or shoot one, and the lamp shows where the line goes.
The ambush has a way round the saw, and the exam has a sheltered lee route.
The gorge glides now wait for your blow, so you pick your gust.
Enemy health bars now show what your last hit took: a white chunk, then it drains away.
Elites and mini-bosses get it too, so a big blow is easy to read.
A graze leaves a thin sliver; a heavy blow takes a thick one.
The Goblin Queen no longer waits on the tower top: when she is hurt she climbs.
The tower burns away under you. Follow her up the ladders, floor by floor.
Her last stand is a stone roof under open sky. Strike her stones back to end it.
The Keep's goblin geomancer can now call down a stone on the spot you stand.
Step out of the ring in time, or you take the hit.
Strike a shard it leaves behind and it flies home and floors him.
Three more goblin geomancers hold the high ground in Highcrown.
Watch the Crag Walk, the Bakehouse Yard and the Keep for stones from above.
Strike a thrown stone back and it knocks the geomancer off his feet.
The Goblin Queen's roof fight starts at once: she stands in front of you.
Her stones now tell you to strike them back, and a hit shows how much it did.
The hitch in her hall when the bell rings is gone. Arrows ring bells too.
The Goblin Queen's fight is reworked: first the hall, then the roof.
In the hall, ring the bell to hoist the lifts and stand clear of the floor fire.
On the roof, strike her stones back, then ring the bell to shake her loose.
Stormwreck Harbor: no more tideguard dropping off the roof into the Salvage Captain.
He now waits on the road past the sea gate instead.
Nothing else in the harbor changed.
Groundwork for a reworked Goblin Queen fight is in; it is switched off for now.
Nothing changes in play yet.
New test hooks for that fight were added for the developers.
The Goblin Princess fights with her blade now. She dashes at you, curtsies, then cuts.
Her tower bell is just a bell now: no more ringing it to bring down the gate.
In her angry phase she throws a tantrum: two slashes, then a big overhead chop.
The Hexed Fields: no more knight dropping in on the Headless Ploughman fight.
A hedge knight that used to walk off the roof into the arena now waits on the road.
A few foes along the Fields road stand in new spots.
The Glassblower is a little fairer.
He has less health than before.
His opening after you shatter glass lasts a bit longer.
Buried City: race the hourglass. Doors, bridges and lifts stand only while the sand runs.
Meet the Glassblower: strike his glass when it glints, then cut him down.
New foe: the Sand Grasper, rising from the sand.
Rangers can strike a glass with a knife tap (X) or E.
A new shrine before the Glassblower's hall.
Smoother title screen on phones.
Co-op rule text fits the screen.
Small text fixes in What's New.
Clearer combat feedback: damage numbers pop, health bars drain smoothly.
Low health pulses the screen edge so you notice it sooner.
Coins chime up a scale as you grab them in a row.
THORNROAD jumping feels crisper: short hops ease out and land sooner.
Ledge corners and low lips forgive more, so you catch edges you used to miss.
Fully held jumps are unchanged.
Groundwork for a new Buried City stretch is in; it is switched off for now.
A crash when a Glassblower or Sand Grasper dies was fixed.
Nothing else changes in play yet.
Groundwork for a Goblin Princess fight is in, switched off.
Nothing changes in play yet.
A new test hook for that fight was added for the developers.
Foes flinch and flash when you hit them.
A hard hit makes a foe pop and stagger.
Dizzy stars now show above a staggered enemy.
Foes die with a bigger pop when you finish them.
The Goblin Princess's bell can now be reached and rung.
Shorter waits on the alarm and the tower gates.
The Goblin Queen keeps her staff in hand while she casts.
Floating props in the castle were set back on the ground.
A death bundle dropped on a ladder no longer hangs in the air.
New music on the castle climb and for the Princess.
On The High Lines, rope ends now sit on iron masts instead of hanging in the air.
Grab and hit prompts now show on screen where you use them.
The Hookjack, Skyhook and crossbow crews up there are goblins now.
A bestiary name on The High Lines was corrected.
The Goblin Princess's tower is bigger: three gates, a guard bell and a spinning blade.
The Highcrown wall walk is longer: a gatehouse, a lead roof and wind to cross.
The Queen's Stair has an armoury landing and a roof with stilt-walkers and fire mages.
Knights in black and gold, stilt-walkers and fire mages now guard the castle.
The Goblin Queen has a hearth fire jet, a sceptre reach and a mountain that falls.
Big skills now hit with real weight: a heavier freeze and kick on every capstone.
Flames sizzle on foes instead of stuttering the fight.
The Warden's spear tip now pops with a star; hit with the shaft and it thuds dull.
Your hero leans into each swing, and heavy swings flash when fully charged.
Hits sound different on wood, bone and steel; the third cut of a combo rings higher.
Kills land with a low boom and a short dip in the music.
Rootway's Huntmaster opens up for longer, so quick blades can land hits
His staggered openings last about 0.8 s longer than before
A little more life on the Huntmaster keeps the fight honest
New level: THE HIGH LINES, up the mountain on ropeways and winches
Grab a line to glide. Tuck with dodge to slip past a swing.
Cut a rope to drop a rider. Ride the gondola and the counterweight.
Meet the Hookjack: his hook guards his front and reaches far.
New boss SKYHOOK: strike his levers, then strike him when he falls.
The Ore Road now comes after it. A save with the Ore Road open keeps it.
The Palisadewood battering beast stays stuck a little longer after it rams the wall
You get a bigger window to hit the beast while it is stuck
Gorm's second half is tougher: fewer openings to strike
Gorm's sceptre hits harder
FOE VARIETY: the desert, canal road and fair mix up the foes you already know
Fire, oil and thirst scorpions, Ksar raptors, vultures and drowned in the pyramid
Order paladins at Waymeet and Warcairn: wait for the gleam, then parry
Goblin kites in the Rookery, club goblins in the Kitchen Gate, mimics in the Tower
Store Skills tab: your core passives and worn traits show under your abilities
Trait slots show their level, an open slot reads EMPTY, the 2nd opens at level 20
The abilities list shows 4 rows a page to make room
HIT FEEL: every blow has a short freeze, longer on heavy hits and kills
Heavier weapons hit heavier
Light melee cuts lose the old swing arc
HERO TRAITS: heroes keep core passives and wear the rest as traits
Traits grow with your level (I, II, III); a second slot opens at level 20
Clear a region once to unlock a shared trait any hero can wear
A feedback form in the game: tell us what you think without leaving it
Goblin Queen fixed: her crown can no longer soft-lock the fight
What's New now flags every new update, even two on the same day
NEW LEVEL: WISPWOOD, a dead wood where only what the light touches is real
NEW BOSS: the Lantern Widow, waiting in the Widow's Glade
NEW LEVEL: THE SILK UNDERCROFT, the web beneath the manor
NEW LEVEL: THE HOLLOW MANOR, the house above the undercroft
NEW LEVEL: THE MAGE ACADEMY, with the Headmistress waiting at the end
Heroes move better in the air: new jump, fall, hit, skid, slide and crouch animations
GOBLIN QUEEN reworked: a told bell-lure charge, a blink that really fires, a sealed hatch
The Goblin Princess fight is tuned and her bell tower is fair to climb
Highcrown fixes: no goat on the Crag Walk, the banquet hearth drawn as a real hearth
The Ram Lord can now butt a boulder loose from the cliff: jump it
The inn has a STORE at the bar, and a better What's New by level
Co-op partners climb tall levels better and can ping the way
HIGHCROWN rebuilt: a longer climb with battlements, two alarm towers and a bell tower
Ring a bell or rope with any blow: a gate drops, a hatch opens, murder holes drop on foes
NEW BOSS: the Goblin Princess, cornered in her bell tower after a chase along the wall
Goblin Queen: ring the bell to drop the grate on her; the winch holds back her guards
The Captains Hall and the bakehouse yard stay, with new banquet and belfry rooms
New in Settings > Picture: Screen fit (Sharp/Fill) and Resolution.
The title is alive: the heroes walk in to the fire
A controls line under PRESS ANY KEY: keyboard or gamepad, 1 to 4 players
Leave the title idle and the game plays itself, arcade style (any key stops it)
A tidier title menu, and PLAY WITH AI under PLAY TOGETHER
New EASY and HARD modes: five difficulties from VERY EASY to MASTER
Lives follow your difficulty: 10, 5, 3, 2 or 1 (Master has no coin lives)
A lives icon on the HUD shows how many you have left
Find it too hard? Lower your difficulty from the pause menu (never back up)
The Ram Lord is re-tuned for a fairer fight
Frog King: swell-throat BELLOW can be burst with three sac blows; fewer hoppers
Bog Troll: lay planks from farther away; a thrown plank stuns him
Goblin Chieftain: shorter openings, kegs need a timed kick, a told three-blow combo
World map: names show near your cursor only; hold C to show every name
One badge per map node, a smaller info card, no ghosts of beaten bosses
New save: choose LIVES (off, or 5 plus one per 100 coins) and your DIFFICULTY
Every hero starts with a first skill ready; UNLOCKS shows how to open everything
SWAP HERO: heroes you unlock are yours in every save, with bonus XP to catch up
After a level: onward or back to the map. The tutorial now teaches every swing
Sporewood shows how to grow the mushrooms; the store has a BACK button
A hard-won win over King Gorm shows the burning wood; the level timer starts off
Starting at the War Cairn boss now wakes the Chieftain right away
Picking the Undead Archmage from the boss list wakes him at once
Boss list: all 69 fights re-checked to start awake at the door
THE DUEL PIT (BETA) is open: pick a fighter, then set lives, health, rounds and the bot
THE GUEST BOOK at THE INN: your five save slots, with the co-op rules on the board
The lesson is now the TUTORIAL; R no longer returns you to a shrine (use the pause menu)
First-time help: a card after your first death, boss hints and short explainers
Fixes: a new save reads NEW GAME; heroes land before the walk-out; Battering Beast fixes
New saves open with a short roadside lesson: move, jump, fight, drink, shrine
Replay the lesson any time from the board at THE INN
The tavern is now THE INN
New foes: the club goblin, plus fire, rock and venom archers
Fen Road, Stockade, Underleaf, Palisade Wood and Kingswood have a livelier cast
Knight: a full-charge quake, and a shield bash on a double tap of block
Kingswood's Great Hound is tougher, with a feeding gallery to strike from
The Windcaller on Gale Moor hits harder, and every hero can answer his blade
The Queen's Lance is sturdier and no longer glides on planted feet
The Foreman and the great drill have new tells and polish
Duel mode is sturdier behind the scenes; clearer Hound hints
The world map is repainted: plates, a clearer header, DANGER pips and living campfires
The Knight no longer doubles his shield while charging
Grubbag fights with a hook and chains, and hits harder
Lance reworked, and the Ranger bell and spear are fixed
Kingswood banner poles and spear racks now stand on the ground
After Kingswood the war horn sounds and the village burns on the horizon
Phone title screen: full thumb-sized rows, PREVIOUS / MORE paging, whole tagline
The Hornet's Nest: glowing smoke pots, tidier fights, a deeper nest, lob pots at the Queen
The Knight charges on the move, kicking up dust and sparks as he walks
The Pyromancer's fireball grows as you hold it, and at full it is a little sun
Early bosses retuned: more health and longer openings, so the fights are fairer
Geomancer: walk through your own stones, tap DOWN to recall them
Geomancer's ultimate is now Mountain Collapse: a wave of boulders
Old Tusker's stomp: a shockwave to jump
The Hornet's Nest drips dark amber resin, not honey
Sound on phones unlocks reliably, and the credits list the new music

lines: Geomancer: DOWN+C detonates stones, crouch for Stone Skin, a rising uppercut

lines.s: Wasps and hornets wear glossy shells, and the Hornet Queen is redrawn
The Arena Yard is the one training ground, and the tavern has a Duel Pit

lines: Floating platforms fixed: posts, braces and masonry under the decks

lines.s: The Hornet's Nest looks cleaner, with no sliding leaf trim
New Arena Yard: practice every move on straw dummies that grade your parries

lines: Pyromancer: Meteor becomes the Fire Lance; Knight cuts harder

lines.s: Geomancer: longer dodge, stone pips on your staff; Warden and Hornet Nest art
Kingswood fire foes, and Gorm now keeps a crimson-and-gold court

lines: A GIVE FEEDBACK button on the title and pause menus
Warden: a javelin throw replaces the spear brace
Ranger: SNARE is a skill you buy, DOWN+C recalls your arrow
Geomancer: an up-air fan and an earthfall shockwave
Gale Spires: updrafts so the gorge pockets cannot trap you

lines.s: Told warnings on more boss moves, and fairer Hornet Queen and Potion Master fights
Hornet's Nest combs now sag, and the Hornet Queen and Battering Beast have new art
Hornet Queen, Old Tusker and Battering Beast are re-tuned for a fairer fight
King Gorm's rage now roars, and his fight is re-tuned
After Gorm, the road ends on the map with the Burning Village lit

lines: Starter-hero fixes: Ranger Great Arrow, Knight riposte timing

lines.s: New Bog Troll fight, and the Goblin Chieftain at the Stockade gets a full art pass
The Pyromancer duel is rebuilt: new fire tells you can read, and a buckets-and-ward fight
King Gorm has new art and sound, and his enrage lifts the music

lines: Hits land heavier: weightier hit-stop, shake and pad rumble on big blows
Hub polish: new loading screen, one-panel hero swap, shops with life
BRACKEN is now THORNROAD: new title and loading screen, and a new road-and-goblins opening

lines.s: Burning Village opens when you beat King Gorm without dying; co-op shares the credit
Frog King has less health; Pyromancer: tap C to ward, hold C to build a fireball
Fixes: Stockade horn soft-lock, late music, Palisade Wood steps; the map road runs past it
Shriek Sisters reworked: one hunts while two roost, and a grab drags you off the stair
The Rookery is tuned for all three heroes and its fight runs longer

lines: Late game: sea guards plant plates, harpoon scouts, clinching zombies
Late-game packs and affixes now scale by act, so the sea and the desert bite harder

lines.s: Platforming fixes: spore, fair, caravan, theatre, church, rootway and more jump cleaner

lines: Pyromancer: tap C for a fire ward (parry), hold C for a growing fireball, stoke for heat
Freebooter: tap C to catch a blow on the hook and snag the weapon, or fling a bolt back
Warden: hold C to brace the spear haft; Ranger: hold C to guard with the bow
Blood Knight: blood paid to block builds as debt, three blocks power up the next blow

lines.s: Lance 4 loads lighter; the Great Drill is kinder in phase 3 and the Forge room is shorter

lines: Late game: stat picks halve past 16 per stat, flasks heal at most 150, skills hit fairer

lines.s: Lord Grubbag: a coal trench, meat-hook rails and a second helping for each dish

lines: Gate bells lock for 1 second at most, so you can ring them again sooner

lines.s: The Lumber Trail leads on to the Hornet Nest again (no ferry skipping past it)

lines: The Undead Mage realm now speaks in the hint box

lines.s: Lance 4 fights on foot: no horse, three tempos of attack, a thrust, a sweep or a charge
Ring the gate bells to bring his charge down on him: pinned under the portcullis
Cut the signal ropes in the second phase to whip him; the great bell ends the third
Stormhold is longer and tougher: gate towers, signal ropes and a gatehouse hoarding
False Abbot: a camera pan shows the basket, a glow and ghost chair mark the ride down

lines: Hop from one zip-line to the next: only the rope you just left is locked out
Every boss and mini-boss fight now starts with your health restored

lines.s: Shrines moved closer to the boss doors in Sporewood, Hornet Nest and Underwell
New shrines before the Kingswood hound and the Minecart foreman and Great Drill
The Archmage falls: ride his carpet back up the broken tower, burst into his sky
The tower comes down around you: a collapse front, a falling bell, a harder Undead Mage

lines: The realms come apart: broken floors, a lower ceiling, a surging mire, three ice lances

lines.s: Two War-Runner berserkers on the War Cairn are tougher elites: swift and unstoppable
Fix: a death on the War Cairn no longer leaves its drum gates open
The War Cairn puts back its bridge, slabs and fallen stones when you respawn
The False Abbot punishes the wrong blow: ride his basket down to throw him out
The Kitchen Gate is longer: hop between meat-hook rails, ride the haul line, time the flue
The Shriek Sisters strike heavy, medium or light; the Rookery stair is longer
The War Cairn: climb to the clan, beat the Berserker Chieftain, win the Berserker
Strike war drums to open gates; the Berserker is bought after beating him

lines: The Blood Knight lashes, drinks and frenzies: new blood art and a Vitae drop

lines.s: The Archmage falls: the Falling Tower is a chase down four rooms and back up
Break the pillars and ride the collapse: new tower rooms, bookcases, columns and a rug
His fall, landing and floor-tear are drawn; the tower rooms are painted
The False Abbot is a new fight: make the house answer the blow
Lord Grubbag sits and the Kitchen Gate is reworked: knock the dishes off the line
The Windcaller is a harder duel: ride the gale updraft, climb the new Gale Stair

lines: Arena polish: new lights and weather across five levels

lines.s: The Scree has loose cliffs to knock down on the road
The Rookery is rebuilt: ride the harpies up the crag, and meet the Gale Harpy
The Shriek Sisters fight is reworked: a cornered opening, and the Snatch
Highcrown is rebuilt around a tall keep hall; the Goblin Queen rings her own bell
The Flotilla has Powder Monkeys, and the Admiral gets longer openings and more health
Boss polish: the Chieftain's horn pulls his crew away; the Dune Worm keeps the sun on
The Deep Rails: a smelter floor, a loader who kicks ore carts, and the Forgemaster
Stormhold is rebuilt as the Outer Works: a barbican, murder holes and a dry moat
The Queen's Lance is a plate-armoured champion on a charger, with new tells to learn
The Hurricane Deck is rebuilt: the waist floods, the sea rises, the Captain holds the mast
Ore Road: dark stretches with lamps to light, rocks to throw and carts to shove
King Gorm walks and steps now; the Ram Lord is a tougher fight

lines: Fixed: the game no longer stalls at 14% loading when an ad blocker is on

lines.s: The Admiral's fight is unchanged - only a file was renamed

lines: If it still stalls, reload once to drop the old copy

lines.s: New level: the Kitchen Gate, and Lord Grubbag the Glutton with his belly flop
New level: the Rookery, a harpy crag climb, with the Shriek Sisters at the top
The Sisters dive in chains, drop boulders, shock-shriek and grab: learn each tell
The Flotilla is remade: deck guns, a captured sloop and the Admiral in hull plate

lines: New pirates: pistoleers, keg rollers, plated bosuns and grapnel boarders

lines.s: New music for the Kitchen Gate, Lord Grubbag, the Rookery and the Sisters
The Palisade Wood is reworked: a siege Battering Beast, the Breach, and the Hornsman
Underleaf is reworked: the Potion Master and potion platforming, now after the Rootway
The Hanging Village is polished: new rope bridges, boughs and posts
The road: Rootway, Underleaf, Palisade Wood, Kingswood, Scree Path, Hanging Village
The road changes: Kingswood, then the Scree Path, then Underleaf, then the Hanging Village
Underleaf now belongs to act II
The Pyromancer duel is tougher: more health and less time to rest between his attacks

lines: Old saves carry over: levels you cleared stay cleared

lines.s: New level: the Palisade Wood, an autumn forest before Kingswood, with the Battering Beast
Underleaf rebuilt: the Grandmother's jars, and a new Grandmother fight
Burning Village: water waves, a soaking, and falling debris
Hanging Village: cut ropes to ride them, and the Owl Reeve now fights on ropes
The Ram Lord on the Scree Path is easier: bigger openings to hit him
A clear warning shows when the Ram Lord can be stunned
Three new spore-cap platforming gauntlets in the Sporewood
The Hornet's Nest is now level 2, before the Marsh
The Queen fights in one hall: resin floods it, drop combs on her
New foe: the Amber Hornet

lines: Co-op: every player carries flasks, fairer scaling
Secrets: hidden paths show your progress once found

lines.s: Sporewood rebuilt: spores help you now (bounce caps, lantern caps, mend puffs)
Six new areas in Sporewood
The Mother Cap returns: plunge her knot to open her. She has a face now

lines: The Ranger switches BOW and KNIFE on any controller; arrows show under the XP bar

lines.s: The Blood Knight is fairer against the Crusader at Waymeet
The Hornet's Nest: a new side path off the Lumber Trail - climb a giant paper nest
Cut comb to make steps, and carry smoke pots to quiet the swarms
The Hornet Queen returns: perch dives, smoke, a falling nest and the great pine
New music for the Nest and her fight
King Gorm: bigger cages you can drop any time, and a longer burning escape
Gorm now waits for you in the glade (bug fix)
Kingswood rebuilt: the King's Hunting Wood
King Gorm's new fight: a burning wood escape and the King's Glade

lines: Ranger's third charge tier is now TRIPLE SHOT
Berserker and Geomancer charge in three tiers
Blood Knight dodge is now the BLOOD STEP
Smoother boss fights on phones

lines.s: The Fen Road rebuilt: lay planks to finish the road
Stilt-walkers stomp, bog leeches bite
A new swamp look for the Fen Road

lines: Ranger bow charges in three tiers
Co-op shows every player hero and level

lines.s: Stockade looks better, no more stray glow blobs
The Chieftain is tougher
Frog King: the royal pads are bigger
New Fen Road music
The Chieftain winds a war horn, throws kegs
Stockade barrels are a level verb now
Frog King: a chase across royal lily pads

lines: Rafts come back when you fall in the water
Blood Knight: Blood Bolt, Drain, Bloodworms
Blood Spike on any blow; a pool of blood

lines.s: THE FEN ROAD: Bog Troll, goblin stilt-walkers

lines: Blood Knight: Red Host names, darker boss, poses

lines.s: Windcaller: every hero can send his bolt home
Windcaller: fairer thorns on the summit
Unburied Field: cairn climb fixed, blocks push
Old Tusker stays dazed longer
A ferry cutscene carries you wood to marsh

lines: AI PARTNER seat: play co-op with a bot ally

lines.s: Old Tusker rams felled trunks, not standing pines

lines: Blood Knight: heavier parry, five-tier heavy
Acts I-II foes told; bosses retuned
Save slots are now called SAVE 1-5

lines.s: OLD TUSKER: a great boar boss in a felling clearing
Fell a marked pine on him. Boars replace badgers

lines: Pine moths + kite goblins replace the wasps

lines.s: MARSH 3: Reed Run, the Boom, the Night Pads

lines: Readable lily pads, centred raft sign

lines.s: The Frog King music now plays on time

lines: THE BLOOD KNIGHT: Death Knight hero + boss renamed
Crimson look, Blood Debt, Blood Price, five-tier heavy
Blood Spike: a low parry. Crimson blood thralls
CO-OP SAVES MADE CLEAR: party board shows each seat
Checkpoint toasts, win-card SAVED TO row, Tavern sign

lines.s: Lumber Trail: felled bridges and trees stay
Lumber Trail look finished: new forest floor
Hornet nests gone from the Lumber Trail
New Lumber Trail music: Enchanted Festival
Marsh Wood reworked: drain the village
The Frog King rebuilt: three phases
New music: Marsh, Frog King, Chieftain

lines: The Tavern, settings inside, PARTY BOARD
Co-op saves: guests level their own hero
Later acts hit harder: foes in acts III-V
